verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical uniform shrinks of the original. The headline, stained-glass window and date/address block keep the original left-to-right order without collisions, but the right-hand date/address text drops to a very small size and is hard to read in the short canvas. In A the window sits slightly high, with a tight top margin and more empty space below, so it is off-centre from the text. B centres the window a touch better vertically, so the two are otherwise equivalent.
